lines.japanese: 「なになに隼人君、なんの話？」
lines.english: “What is it? Hayato, what are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、あの、アレだ。鳳、おまえの妹のことなんだけど」
lines.english: “Oh, right. That. Ohtori, it's about your sister.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！」
lines.english: “Hah!”

lines.japanese: 俺が足を組みなおしながら切りだすと、やつは予想通り一笑に付した。
lines.english: I brought it up as I recrossed my legs, and just like I'd expected, he laughed it off.

lines.japanese: 「え～っ、鳴ちゃんのこと？」
lines.english: “What? About Naru?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、アレか？　盗まれたチャリの話か？」
lines.english: “Oh, that? The stolen bike?”

lines.japanese: 亜衣と森里が、バーガー屋の期間限定メニューに寄せる興味程度の中途半端な関心を向けてきた。それはちょっと疎ましかったけれど、いまの俺には鳳とふたりきりに戻る気力がなかった。
lines.english: Ai and Morisato showed the same halfhearted interest they might have given a burger chain's limited-time special. It was mildly annoying, but I no longer had the strength to go back to being alone with Ohtori.

lines.japanese: 「そう、そのチャリっつーか、チャリのカゴに入ってたポケベルの話なんだけど」
lines.english: “Yeah. The bike—or rather, the pager that was in its basket.”

lines.japanese: 「ポケベル！？」
lines.english: “A pager!?”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　ケータイじゃなくて？」
lines.english: “What? Not a cell phone?”

lines.japanese: 亜衣と和馬は、俺の口から飛びだしたレトロな単語に予想通りの反応を見せた。なんで？　いまどき？　まだ使えんの？
lines.english: Ai and Kazuma reacted to the retro word exactly as I'd expected. Why? These days? They still work?

lines.japanese: ひとしきり騒ぎおえるのを待ってから、俺はそれが母親からの贈り物だということを説明した。やつらは成程という顔をして頷いた。
lines.english: Once they'd finished making noise, I explained that it was a gift from her mother. They nodded with looks that said, ‘Oh, that makes sense.’

lines.japanese: 「ふうん、お母さんのね……」
lines.english: “Oh. From her mother...”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとぉ、翔さんお兄ちゃんでしょ、なんか言ってよ」
lines.english: “Come on, Kakeru. You're her brother. Say something.”

lines.japanese: 終始薄ら笑いで無言を貫いていた鳳に、亜衣が物怖じせず意見を求めた。
lines.english: Kakeru had sat there with a faint grin, saying nothing the whole time. Ai asked him what he thought without acting intimidated in the least.

lines.japanese: 「賢しらな小娘だ。貴様にはまだ言ってなかったか？」
lines.english: “What an impertinent little girl. Have I not told you yet?”

lines.japanese: やつは冷めた笑いを崩さずに答えた。
lines.english: His cold smile never shifted as he answered.

lines.japanese: 「もはや俺はあの家と無縁の人間だ。あの鳴というガキが、過去にすがろうと血を重んじようと興味もない」
lines.english: “I have no connection to that house any longer. Whether the child called Naru clings to the past or cherishes ties of blood is of no interest to me.”

lines.japanese: 興味もない──まさにそんな口調だった。
lines.english: No interest. His voice said exactly that.

lines.japanese: 誰も言葉を継げず、にわかに防音ガラス越しの遠い音楽とはしゃぎ声が際立った。亜衣の垂れさがった腕を、森里が気まずげに肘で突付いていた。余計なこと言うなよ、の意。
lines.english: With no one able to answer, the distant music and happy shouts beyond the soundproof glass suddenly filled the silence. Morisato gave Ai’s dangling arm an awkward nudge with his elbow: *Don’t say anything else.*

lines.japanese: 「じゃあさ」
lines.english: Okay, then...

lines.japanese: 続きは俺が受けもった。
lines.english: I took over from there.

lines.japanese: 「いち他人としてどうよ。そういう健気なガキの話を聞いてどうよ」
lines.english: “Forget being her brother. As a complete stranger, what do you think? You hear about a kid trying that hard—what do you think?”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！」
lines.english: “Hah!”

lines.japanese: 鳳は一笑した。
lines.english: Ohtori laughed.

lines.japanese: 「答えは同じだ。興味がない」
lines.english: “My answer is the same. I have no interest.”

lines.japanese: 「つーか成田さあ、おまえもどんな答え期待してんだよ。翔さんがどう言ったところで、それは鳴さんとお袋さんの問題だろ。なんも解決しねーじゃん」
lines.english: “I mean, Narita, what answer are you even hoping for? Whatever Kakeru says, this is between Naru and her mother. Nothing he says is going to solve it.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、カズ君ひどーい」
lines.english: “What? Kazu, that's awful.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だってそーじゃん！　可哀想だけどさあ！」
lines.english: “But it's true! I feel sorry for her, sure!”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ。ふだん無口なお兄ちゃんがここで『がんばれえ』とか言っとけば、鳴ちゃんたぶんそれだけでも喜ぶってば」
lines.english: “That’s not true. If her big brother, who never says anything, just told her, ‘Keep going,’ I bet that alone would make Naru happy.”

lines.japanese: 「……ああ。かもな」
lines.english: “...Yeah. Maybe.”

lines.japanese: 俺は頷かずに小さく同意した。鳳に目を戻すと、やつはくすぐったそうに肩を揺らしていた。
lines.english: I murmured my agreement without nodding. When I looked back at Ohtori, his shoulders were quivering as though something tickled him.

lines.japanese: 「ならそう伝えろよ、かつて兄だった男がそう言っていたと。俺が実際口にしたかどうかは関係ねえだろ？　質量のない気休めを施して、やつの崇める錆びついた絆を愛撫してやればいい」
lines.english: “Then tell her so. Say the man who was once her brother spoke those words. Whether I actually did is irrelevant, isn't it? Offer her some weightless consolation. Caress the rusted bond she worships.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おおっ！　さすが翔さん、やーさしー！」
lines.english: “O-oh! That's Kakeru for you! So kiiind!”

lines.japanese: 「どこがだぁー！　ふざけんなし、もぉー！　ちょおヤな言い方じゃーん！」
lines.english: How is thaaat?! Quit screwing around! Jeeez! That's such a nasty way to put it!

lines.japanese: 「な、なんでだよ。じゃあどうしろっつんだよ」
lines.english: “W-why? Then what the hell do you expect him to do?”

lines.japanese: 「あのさ。鳳」
lines.english: “Listen. Ohtori.”

lines.japanese: 俺はここへ来る途中にちょっと考えた、安易で出来すぎた一策を口にしてみた。
lines.english: On the way here, I'd thought of an easy plan that was probably way too convenient, and I gave it a shot.

lines.japanese: 「いや、いろいろ事情はあると思うんだけどさ。そこをなんとかさ。おまえからこう、カーチャンとこ電話なりして、鳴のポケベルにひと言でいいからメッセージ送ってもらうとか、そーゆーの出来ねーかな」
lines.english: Look, I know there's all kinds of stuff going on, but couldn't you, y'know, work something out? Like, call your mom and have her send a message to Naru's pager, just one line, or... can you do something like that?

lines.japanese: 「ふっ！」
lines.english: “Pfft!”

lines.japanese: やつは大袈裟に吹きだしてみせ、左手を腹に添えた。
lines.english: He burst into exaggerated laughter and put his left hand to his stomach.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハ！　面白いぞ隼人！　いかにも美談を好む凡人好みの筋書きだ、腹がよじれて苦痛すら覚える！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha ha! You amuse me, Hayato! Exactly the sort of sentimental little story the common herd adores. I’m laughing so hard it hurts!”

lines.japanese: 「無理か」
lines.english: “Can't be done?”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳳のハイテンションを無視して真剣に訊いた。やつは目で笑ったまま、豪快な鼻嵐を吹いた。
lines.english: Ignoring Ohtori’s manic energy, I asked him in earnest. Still laughing with his eyes, he gave a thunderous snort.

lines.japanese: 「鳴は昔から父親似だと言われていた。どちらも皿から零れた苺をベッドに潜るまで惜しんでいるようなやつらだった。俺はガキのころ、しばしば母親似だと言われた。俺は別れた女の名を三歩で忘れるタチだ」
lines.english: “Naru was always said to take after our father. They were both the sort to go to bed still mourning a strawberry that had fallen off their plate. As a child, I was often said to take after our mother. I am the sort who forgets a woman’s name before I have gone three steps.”

lines.japanese: 鳳が洋画の俳優みたいに両手を広げて肩をすくめた。亜衣はアニメのキャラクターみたいに目をぱちぱちさせたあと、隣りにいた幼なじみに声をひそめて尋ねた。
lines.english: Ohtori spread his hands and shrugged like a Hollywood actor. Ai blinked like an anime character, then lowered her voice and asked her childhood friend beside her:

lines.japanese: 「え……どゆこと」
lines.english: “What... does that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ばか、分かれよ。だから、その……たぶんお袋さんはもう昔のことを……っていうさあ」
lines.english: “Idiot, figure it out. He means... their mother has probably forgotten the old days by now.”
“What!?”

lines.japanese: 亜衣がいきなり腹の底から声をあげて、森里を慌てふためかせた。
lines.english: Ai suddenly shouted at the top of her lungs, sending Morisato into a panic.

lines.japanese: 「ないない、そんなことないよ！　恋愛と親子の情は違うよ、親が子供のこと忘れるわけないじゃん！」
lines.english: “No, no, that's not true! Romance and love between parent and child are different. A parent can't just forget their child!”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハ！　それこそ理想の夢物語だ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha ha! Now *that* is an idealist's fairy tale!”

lines.japanese: ドラッグの効能で、抑えていた感情までも昂ぶってしまったのだろうか。しかしやつがどれだけ笑いとばしてみても、俺にはその血走った目が怒りや悲しみに似た激情を併せもっているように見えた。
lines.english: Perhaps the drug had excited even the emotions he usually kept suppressed. Yet however hard he tried to laugh it off, his bloodshot eyes still seemed to blaze with anger and grief.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、歩きはじめたばかりの牝豚が！　ありふれた定規で世界のすべてを図れるなどとは考えるなよ。やつは俺たちを見捨て、海の向こうへ逃げかえった女だ。捨てた子供のかき鳴らす雑音など届くものかよ！」
lines.english: “Hah! A little sow who has barely learned to walk! Do not imagine you can measure the whole world with your commonplace ruler. She abandoned us and fled back across the sea. Do you think the noise scraped out by the children she discarded could ever reach her?”

lines.japanese: 鳳は気付いているのだろうか。いまや無関係だと断じた妹を、自身と総じて「俺たち」と括ったことに。
lines.english: Did Ohtori realize what he had done? He had just said *us*, drawing the sister he’d declared irrelevant back together with himself.

lines.japanese: しかし、あざなえる関係の一端を垣間見て、俺も亜衣も今度こそ言葉を失った。
lines.english: But that glimpse of the twisted strands binding them silenced both Ai and me at last.

lines.japanese: 迂闊だった。部外者が安っぽい理想を盾に踏みこんでいい領域じゃなかった。そんなこと、誰よりも分かっていたはずなのに。
lines.english: I'd been careless. This was no territory an outsider should invade behind the shield of cheap ideals. I should have understood that better than anyone.

lines.japanese: 「分かった。悪かった」
lines.english: “All right. I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 俺は肩を落とし、鳴の兄に気持ち頭を下げた。やつは何も言わずに鼻を鳴らした。
lines.english: I let my shoulders sag and gave Naru’s brother a slight bow. He said nothing, only snorted.

lines.japanese: 「でもさ。ひとつだけいいかな」
lines.english: “Still. Can I ask you one thing?”

lines.japanese: 「さっき、おまえさ。俺から鳴に、家族の思いやりを捏造して伝えるのは別にいいっつったよな」
lines.english: Hey, a minute ago... you said you didn't care if I, like, made up some family affection and told Naru about it, right?

lines.japanese: 「え、そこまで言ったか？」
lines.english: “Did he really go that far?”

lines.japanese: 「カズ君、うっさい！」
lines.english: “Kazu, shut up!”

lines.japanese: 俺は森里の茶々を無視して、鳳から言質が取れるのを待った。
lines.english: Ignoring Morisato’s heckling, I waited for Ohtori to commit himself.

lines.japanese: 「なあ。いいんだろ」
lines.english: “Well? That's fine, right?”

lines.japanese: 「好きにしろよ」
lines.english: “Do whatever you want.”

lines.japanese: やつが肩をすくめた。
lines.english: He shrugged.

lines.japanese: 「おまえがあの娘に都合のいい虚言を弄したところで、どのみち俺の耳まで入りはしない。俺が貴様を責めることは不可能だ」
lines.english: “Whatever convenient falsehood you tell that girl, it will never reach my ears. It will therefore be impossible for me to hold you to account.”

lines.japanese: 「おう、言ったな。じゃあ好きにさせてもらうわ。ありがとよ」
lines.english: “Good. You said it. Then I'll do as I please. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 俺はポケットに両手を突っこんで、頭を下から上へ振った。
lines.english: I buried both hands in my pockets and jerked my chin upward.

lines.japanese: 「ほんでさ。ついでなんだけど」
lines.english: “And while we're at it...”

lines.japanese: 「あいつのポケベルの番号。知ってんだろ、ちょっと教えてくんない」
lines.english: “You know her pager number, right? Mind telling me?”

lines.japanese: 鳳は吹きだすような溜息を吐いて、一度目を閉じた。それから半分だけまぶたを開けた。
lines.english: Ohtori exhaled something between a sigh and a snort, closed his eyes, then opened them halfway.

lines.japanese: 「それを俺が知っていると考えた、おまえの浅はかさは実に愉快だ。だが期待には応えてやれない。知りたけりゃ当人に聞けよ」
lines.english: “That you imagined I would know it is profoundly amusing. Regrettably, I cannot meet your expectations. If you wish to know, ask her yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「アホかおまえ。俺が鳴に番号聞いて、ほんでもって次の日とかにいきなり母親名義のメッセージ届くっておまえ、そんな分かりやしーの誰が信じンだよ。いいから教えろよ、知ってんだろ家族なんだから」
lines.english: “Are you stupid? If I ask Naru for the number and a message supposedly from her mother shows up the next day, who’s going to believe a setup that obvious? Just tell me. You know it. You’re family.”

lines.japanese: 「古い話だ。かつて知っている時代もあったという話だ」
lines.english: “Ancient history. There was once a time when I knew it. Nothing more.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は瞳孔の開いた眼を泳がせるように首を横へ向けた。ゆっくりと腰を上げ、すうっとフロアの一団へ紛れていきそうになる。
lines.english: Ohtori turned his head aside, his dilated gaze wandering. He slowly rose and began to glide away, as though to disappear among the groups on the floor.

lines.japanese: 「待てよ」
lines.english: “Wait.”

lines.japanese: 俺も慌てて立ちあがり、やつの肩を掴んで座面に押しもどした。
lines.english: I jumped up too, caught his shoulder, and pushed him back onto the seat.

lines.japanese: 「なあ。マジで。頼むよ」
lines.english: “Come on. I mean it. Please.”

lines.japanese: 充血したふたつの眼を真正面から見下ろし、握る手に力を込めた。
lines.english: I looked straight down into his bloodshot eyes and tightened my grip.

lines.japanese: やつは冷ややかな憫笑を漏らした。
lines.english: He gave a cold, pitying laugh.

lines.japanese: 「哀れなツラをしている。いいだろう、愉快なものを見せてもらった礼だ。おまえの望む情報は調べておいてやろう。明日またここへ来い」
lines.english: “What a pathetic face. Very well. In thanks for the entertainment, I shall look into the information you desire. Come here again tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: それが条件だ、と挑発するような眼光が言外に付けたしていた。
lines.english: His challenging gaze added the unspoken condition: *Those are my terms.*

lines.japanese: 俺は鳳の肩から腕を下ろし、天井を走る剥き出しのパイプをわけもなく見上げた。
lines.english: I lowered my arm from Ohtori’s shoulder. For no particular reason, I looked up at the bare pipes running across the ceiling.

lines.japanese: 「分かった。また来る」
lines.english: “All right. I'll come back.”

lines.japanese: 条件を呑むと、やつはくっと喉の奥で笑った。
lines.english: When I accepted his terms, he chuckled deep in his throat.

lines.japanese: 「人払いをして待っていよう。心置きなく話の続きができるようにな」
lines.english: “I shall clear the room and await you. Then we may continue our conversation to our hearts' content.”
“Yeah...”

lines.japanese: 話の続き──それが鳴の話でないことは明白だった。
lines.english: The rest of our conversation. Plainly, he did not mean Naru.

lines.japanese: やつの話。
lines.english: His story.

lines.japanese: あるいは俺の話、俺たちの話。
lines.english: Or perhaps mine. Ours.

lines.japanese: 俺はそれを聞きたいのか聞きたくないのか、自分でもよく分からなかった。しかし何故だか気が重くなる。この胃の痛むような予感はいったい何なんだろう。
lines.english: I didn't know whether I wanted to hear it. Yet for some reason, my spirits sank. What was this sickening sense of foreboding in my gut?

lines.japanese: 「ねーねー、でもさー」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, but listen.”

lines.japanese: 言葉の途切れた間が不穏な緊張感に高じるころ、決まって亜衣のいとけない声が淀んだ空気を攪拌させる。こういうときにはありがたい存在だ。
lines.english: Whenever a break in the conversation swelled into ominous tension, Ai's innocent voice would stir the stagnant air. At times like this, she was a blessing.

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、ポケベルの打ち方なんて知ってるの？」
lines.english: “Hey, Hayato, do you even know how to send a pager message?”

lines.japanese: 「知らない。いや、だからおまえに聞こうと思ったんだけど」
lines.english: “No. That’s why I was going to ask you.”

lines.japanese: 「え、私？　まさか。知ってるわけないじゃん」
lines.english: “Me? No way. Of course I don't.”

lines.japanese: 「……マジで」
lines.english: “...Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと！　なにそれ、私いくつだと思ってんの、失礼すぎなくない！？」
lines.english: “Hey! What's that supposed to mean? How old do you think I am? Isn't that incredibly rude?”

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃ、おまえらは？」
lines.english: “Then what about you guys?”

lines.japanese: 「いや俺、ポケベルなんて触ったこともねーよ」
lines.english: “I've never even touched a pager.”

lines.japanese: 森里は首をぶんぶん横に振った。鳳は煙草に火を点けてから、大仰にかぶりを振った。
lines.english: Morisato shook his head vigorously. Ohtori lit a cigarette, then made an equally theatrical show of shaking his own.

lines.japanese: 「愚問だな。おまえの海馬なら、十年前の失われた文明も記憶していられるのか？」
lines.english: “A foolish question. Do you imagine that hippocampus of yours retains the lost technology of a civilization ten years dead?”

lines.japanese: 「え……ちょ、マジかよ。誰も知らねーのかよ」
lines.english: “Wait... Seriously? Nobody knows?”

lines.japanese: 俺は新たなる窮地に立たされた。
lines.english: I found myself in a fresh predicament.

lines.japanese: 「またネットで調べてみれば？」
lines.english: “Why not look it up online again?”

lines.japanese: 「いやアレはもうマジ勘弁」
lines.english: “No. Seriously. Never again.”

lines.japanese: そしてさらに追いつめられた。
lines.english: The walls closed in further.

lines.japanese: しかし、あとひとり──あとひとりだけ、俺には心当たりがあった。
lines.english: But there was one more person—one last person who might know.

lines.japanese: フワフワやかましいユーロビートとパラパラに十代の青春を費してきた、桃色づくしの元“コギャル”。
lines.english: The woman in head-to-toe pink—a former nineties schoolgirl trendsetter who had spent her teenage years on chirpy, deafening Eurobeat and synchronized club-dance routines.

lines.japanese: よし。窮余の望みをかけて、明日パルクレープへ行ってみよう。
lines.english: All right. Tomorrow I would stake my last desperate hope on a visit to Paru Crêpes.

lines.japanese: 「まあ……なんとかなると思う」
lines.english: “Well... I think things'll work out somehow.”

lines.japanese: 考えこんでいた俺を亜衣がずっと見つめていたので、俺はそう答えた。しかし、それでもやつは視線を外さず、おもむろに右手をすっと顔の横へ持ちあげた。
lines.english: Ai had been watching me brood, so I gave her that answer. Yet she still didn’t look away. Slowly, she raised her right hand beside her face.

lines.japanese: 「あの、ところで質問なんですけど」
lines.english: “Um, I have a question.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに」
lines.english: “Huh? What?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、なんで鳴ちゃんのことンなるとそんな一生懸命スピリッツなの？」
lines.english: “Hayato, why do you get this whole earnest-hero thing going whenever Naru's involved?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 俺は苦笑に眉をひそめた。しかし亜衣は、問いかけの表情を固めてそれを崩さなかった。
lines.english: I gave her a strained smile and furrowed my brow. Ai held her questioning look without wavering.

lines.japanese: わりと真顔な亜衣と目を合わせているのが気まずくなって、森里に目を移した。やつは腕を組んですっとぼけたツラをしていた。
lines.english: Her face was actually pretty serious, and looking her in the eye got awkward, so I glanced at Morisato. He had his arms crossed and was making that dumb play-innocent face.

lines.japanese: 鳳はクリアカップからストローをひっこ抜いて投げすて、ふちに直接口を付けていた。しかし音を立てて吸いこみながらも、こっちの会話はしっかり聞いているような気がした。
lines.english: Ohtori pulled the straw from his clear cup, threw it away, and drank directly from the rim. Yet even as he gulped noisily, I had the feeling he was listening closely to us.

lines.japanese: 「さあ。なんでだろうな。あいつだからじゃねーの」
lines.english: “Who knows. Why do I? Maybe because it's her.”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻きながら答えた。いつもみたいにくだらない戯れ言を並べて否定しなかったせいか、亜衣の目が驚きに膨らんだ。
lines.english: I answered, scratching hard at the back of my head. Perhaps because I hadn’t denied it with my usual string of asinine jokes, Ai’s eyes widened in surprise.

lines.japanese: 「好きなの？」
lines.english: “Do you like her?”

lines.japanese: やつは率直に訊いてきた。単純な質問だけど、答えるのは難しかった。
lines.english: She asked directly. A simple question, but a difficult one to answer.

lines.japanese: 「かもしんねえ」
lines.english: “Maybe.”

lines.japanese: 俺は中途半端な回答を出したが、最後まで目は逸らさなかった。
lines.english: I gave her half an answer, but never looked away.

lines.japanese: だから、先に亜衣の視線が外れた。
lines.english: So Ai's eyes were the first to turn aside.

lines.japanese: やつは一度、ガラスの向こうへ視点を置いた。闇に踊る光と群衆。
lines.english: For a moment, she let her gaze rest beyond the glass, on the lights and the crowd dancing in the dark.

lines.japanese: 真横を向いたまま息をひとつついて、それからまた正面の俺に向きなおり──なにか言おうと口を開けた。
lines.english: Still turned aside, she exhaled once. Then she faced me again and opened her mouth to speak—

lines.japanese: しかし、けっきょく深呼吸をしただけで言葉は吐かなかった。
lines.english: But in the end, she only drew a deep breath and said nothing.

lines.japanese: 「亜衣。ＤＪ変わる前に踊っとかねーと。行こうぜ」
lines.english: “Ai. If we don't dance before the DJ changes, we'll miss our chance. Come on.”

lines.japanese: 森里が席を立ってダンスフロアへ向かった。女に声はかけたが、返事は待たずにひとりで突きすすんでいった。扉を閉める一瞬、俺に険しい表情を向けたような気もした。
lines.english: Morisato rose and headed for the dance floor. He called out to her but didn’t wait for an answer, striding ahead alone. In the instant before the door closed, I thought he turned a hard look on me.

lines.japanese: 「むかつく……ぐれてやる」
lines.english: “That pisses me off... Fine. I'll become a delinquent.”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は制服のブレザーから腕を抜くと、泣く子も黙るＹＦＢの鳳翔めがけ「持ってて」という声といっしょにそれを投げつけていった。
lines.english: Ai slipped out of her school blazer, cried, “Hold this!” and hurled it at Kakeru Ohtori, dread emperor of the Yanagihara Flame Birds.

lines.japanese: 頭からすっぽり女物の上着を被った柳木原の皇帝は、それを剥ぎとらないままグラスに口を付けた。
lines.english: The Emperor of Yanagihara drank from his glass with the woman's jacket still draped entirely over his head.

lines.japanese: ガラス越しにそのさまを発見した下っ端ヤンキーが、血相変えて飛びこんできて、丁重にそれを剥いで脇へ置いていった。
lines.english: A low-ranking delinquent spotted him through the glass and rushed in, white-faced. With elaborate deference, he peeled off the blazer and set it aside.

lines.japanese: 「隼人。おまえ、さっきまで鳴と会ってたッつったなァ」
lines.english: “Hayato. You said you were with Naru till a little while ago, didn’t you?”

lines.japanese: 鳳が掠れた声で言った。この男が妹を名前で呼ぶことはそう多くない。
lines.english: Ohtori spoke in a hoarse voice. This man rarely called his sister by name.

lines.japanese: あー。俺は口を縦に広げ、短く頷いた。
lines.english: I shaped my mouth into a silent *ah* and nodded once.

lines.japanese: 「たかられなかったか？」
lines.english: “Did she hit you up for anything?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: やつは俺に流し目をくれて薄く笑った。ぎらついた虹彩はサイケデリックな世界を映しているのだろうか。その表情がひととき穏やかな兄の顔になった──気がする。
lines.english: He gave me a sidelong look and smiled faintly. Perhaps his glittering irises reflected some psychedelic world. For one moment, his expression seemed to become that of a gentle older brother.

lines.japanese: 「貴様がつまんねえ話をするから、俺までつまんねえことを思いだした。１２月１日……今日はあいつが母親の子宮から引きずりだされた日だ」
lines.english: “That stupid story of yours made me remember something just as stupid. December first... Today’s the day she was dragged out of her mother’s womb.”

lines.japanese: 俺は舌の先で頬の裏側を突いた。
lines.english: I pressed my tongue against the inside of my cheek.

lines.japanese: 誕生日。
lines.english: Her birthday.

lines.japanese: なるほどだ。素直におねだりできない殊勝な笑顔を思いだしながら、俺は親指で鼻の頭を弾いた。
lines.english: So that was it. I thought of her brave little smile when she couldn’t bring herself to ask outright, then flicked the tip of my nose with my thumb.

lines.japanese: 「なあ。シスコン兄貴。念のため聞いとくけど──」
lines.english: “Hey, you overprotective creep. One question, just to be safe—”

lines.japanese: 俺はスポーツバッグを担ぎあげた。帰り支度はただそれだけだった。
lines.english: I hoisted the sports bag onto my shoulder. That was all I had to do to get ready to leave.

lines.japanese: 「──あんさ、おまえさ。やっぱ大事な妹に変な虫とか付いたら、チーム集めてその男フルボッコにしちゃったりすんの」
lines.english: “—if some sketchy guy started sniffing around your precious little sister, would you call the whole team and beat him half to death?”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　何度も言わせるなよ。くだらない。関係ない。興味がない」
lines.english: “Hah! Don’t make me say it again. It’s stupid. It’s got nothing to do with me. I don’t care.”

lines.japanese: やつは二本目の煙草を抜きだして歯に挟んだ。さっきのニット帽がすかさず灰皿を用意し、火の灯ったライターを近づけた。
lines.english: He drew out a second cigarette and caught it between his teeth. The man in the knit cap instantly produced an ashtray and held up a lit lighter.

lines.japanese: 「だが」
lines.english: “However...”

lines.japanese: 細く伸びる一条の紫煙。
lines.english: One slender thread of purple smoke.

lines.japanese: 「俺は初めから、おまえらが似合いのつがいだと思ってたぜえ？」
lines.english: “I’ve thought from the beginning that the two of you make quite a fitting pair, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Shut up. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 鳳が似合わないことを言うものだから、俺は思わず意味もなく反抗してしまった。
lines.english: Ohtori had said something so unlike him that I snapped back without even knowing why.
